style.backgroundSystem: two-layer system kept identical across the set: a pale studio field #FDF7F4 for packshot, on-body and macro screens, and a warm apricot #F6C6A8 softly washed flat field for cover, callout and spec screens, every canvas finished with a soft apricot #F6C6A8 outer border band; one single dark insert screen on ink #17171A reserved for the material proof, never elsewhere
style.direction: warm editorial women winter outerwear commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in coral red #D6543C inside white circular medallions on the pale field #FDF7F4, one abstract geometric motif per card, identical stroke weight and diameter, no pictograms of seals, awards or certification marks
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio daylight, broad front-left key with a white bounce on the shadow side, gentle wrap on the matte shell, low contrast, soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment, controlled highlight on trim and hardware, no hard speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm editorial women's winter outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm apricot #F6C6A8, pale studio field #FDF7F4, coral red accent #D6543C and one ink dark screen #17171A; soft diffused studio daylight with a broad front-left key, white bounce fill, low contrast and a soft contact shadow grounding the garment; single high-contrast editorial serif family with coral red underlined label system; thin single-weight line icons inside white circular medallions; hung invisible-form garment and chin-down cropped worn view as the only two product scales; stable garment scale and hem position; every canvas finished with a soft apricot border band; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no visible model face or identifiable person
no invented spec numbers, percentages or seals
style.presentationRules: two locked scales only: the hung garment on an invisible ghost form at a stable slight front or 3/4 angle, and the worn view cropped from the chin down so no face ever enters frame; garment scale and hem position stay consistent between screens; flat-lay screens reuse the exact front view of the hung scale; hardware, pocket and trim placement are always read from the reference and never redrawn
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale painted cyclorama #FDF7F4 and warm apricot board #F6C6A8; the dark proof screen uses matte ink #17171A; on-body screens keep a plain pale floor with a soft scuff-free finish
style.typography: one single high-contrast editorial serif family for every rendered line, letterspaced caps only for micro labels, coral red #D6543C underlines as the label system; no sans, no script, no rounded or retro faces mixed in
